ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) field comprising approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Spatially continuous dark field containing discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white blobs scattered across both lobes; there is a higher density of focal white spots near the medial notch and central lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography characterized by high-frequency serrations and several larger-scale indentations (peaks and valleys) along the entire linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in narrow, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixels (likely barnacle colonization points or resulting scars) distributed across the black ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical-to-diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the upper-medial portion of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface and significant irregular erosion/jaggedness along the trailing edge boundary.
